primary_questions: Do pretrained module/region groups show reproducible fixed-model dependence?
Do fixed cPCA scores separate AD from NC externally?
Does cPC1 associate with MMSE within AD after age/sex adjustment?
other_components: Exploratory; include every retained dimension in the multiple-testing family.

groups.edge_region_pairs: Undirected ROI pair; edges appear once only. Summaries report both signed mean and mean absolute magnitude divided by edge count.

permutation.location: Age/sex residual EEG feature layer, after frozen nuisance regression and before frozen center/scale, block weighting, PCA/cPCA and classifier.
permutation.scope: Fixed external model dependence; not an additive percentage and not an inferential p-value.

directions.classifier_weight: Frozen linear decision coefficient mapped to EEG feature coordinates
directions.haufe: Training-only association pattern with model EEG score
directions.group_difference: Separate AD-versus-NC effect; never infer disease direction from model weight or importance.

clinical.mmse_source: Observed original MMSE only; no imputation or converted MMSE
clinical.education: Not in ds004504 metadata; not adjusted
clinical.fdr_family: All retained cPCA component tests across pooled/AD-only scopes and planned adjusted regressions.
